IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA  CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CRIMINAL APPEAL No.56/2026  [Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No.17002/2025]
SARITA
PANDEY APPELLANT  VERSUS  STATE OF CHHATTISGARH RESPONDENT  ORDER 1.
Leave granted.
2. The High Court of Chhattisgarh at Bilaspur, by the impugned judgment and order dated 23 rd April, 2025, has rejected the appellants application for bail in anticipation of arrest.

entities.text: High Court of Chhattisgarh at Bilaspur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Appellant figures as an accused in FIR No.410 of 2024 dated 31st July, 2024 registered at Police Station Bemetara, District Bemetara under Sections 34 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
4. We have heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.

5. There is no statement in the counter affidavit that after this Court issued notice vide order dated 17 th Reason: Crl. Appeal @ SLP(Crl.) No.17002/2025 1 October, 2025 and granted interim protection to the appellant subject to the condition mentioned therein, the appellant was called for interrogation by the investigating officer.

6. Although the charge-sheet is yet to be filed but having regard to the nature of allegations leveled in the FIR coupled with the omission as noticed hereinbefore and the fact that the appellant is a lady, entitled to protection contemplated by Section 480, Bharatiya Nyaya Suraksha Sanhita, 2023,
we are of the considered opinion that the appeal deserves acceptance and the appellant may be admitted to an order for release on bail in anticipation of arrest.
7.
Accordingly, we set aside the impugned judgment and order.
8. It is directed that in the event of the appellant being arrested, she shall be released on bail on terms and conditions to be imposed by the trial court.

10. We clarify that the observations made in this order and grant of bail to the appellant in anticipation of arrest will not be treated as findings on the merits of the case.
11. The appeal is, accordingly, allowed on the aforesaid terms.
12. Pending application(s), if any, stand disposed of.
